sources: https://www.bamf.de/SharedDocs/Anlagen/DE/Integration/Einbuergerung/gesamtfragenkatalog-lebenindeutschland.pdf?__blob=publicationFile&v=23 (official BAMF Gesamtfragenkatalog, Stand 07.05.2025, 191 pages, authoritative for question and option TEXT; contains no answer key)
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abdullahbutt/leben-in-deutschland-test/english/*.md (answer key 2: DE/EN markdown tables, correct row marked)
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/webmansa/german-citizenship-test-data/main/questions.ts (answer key 3: TypeScript question array with correctAnswer index)
method.extractionTool: pdfplumber character-level extraction; lines reconstructed by grouping chars on round(top/3.0), options split on the checkbox glyphs U+F0A3 and U+25A1, questions delimited by bold "Aufgabe N" lines and sections by "Fragen für das Bundesland ..." headings. Text comparison uses NFC + typographic normalisation and a similarity that takes the better of a character-level and a sorted-word-bag Ratcliff/Obershelp ratio.
method.confidence: high for extraction and for question/option text; medium-high for correct answers (three-source consensus, not the official key); not established for the ordering of image assets
caveats: The official BAMF catalogue contains NO answer key: all 1800 checkboxes are the identical empty glyph (Wingdings2 U+F0A3, or U+25A1 for the ten questions added in the 2024/25 revision), confirmed both by font/codepoint inspection and by rendering pages to PNG. Question and option TEXT is therefore verified against the authoritative source, but the CORRECT ANSWER is verified against a consensus of three independent secondary answer keys whose answers were matched back onto the official option text (not by question number, because every source numbers the catalogue differently).

The secondary DE/EN catalogue PDF (ashwinambatwar/Einburgerungstest) does mark answers, but only as filled checkbox IMAGES with identical XObject hashes, so the marking is not text-extractable without pixel analysis. It is also Stand 19.03.2017 and covers only 6 states, so it was not used as a consensus source.

149 option/stem differences are formatting-only (whitespace, quotes, dashes, trailing period) and 261 are gender-doublet word-order differences: our dataset uses the older masculine-first style ("den Regierungschef / die Regierungschefin") where the 2025 catalogue uses feminine-first ("die Regierungschefin/den Regierungschef"). These are counted, not listed as findings.
72 option strings are bare digits ("1") where the catalogue prints "Bild 1"; treated as a presentation convention, not a content difference.

36 questions answer with a picture number rather than text. Their solutions are only correct if our bundled image assets are in the same order as the images in the official catalogue. That ordering could NOT be verified from text and has not been checked against the image files.

11 questions are backed by only one of the three answer sources (F025, F071, F075, F120, F157, F198, F211, F225, F233, F261, F282) — these are the questions added in the 2024/25 catalogue revision, which the older answer keys do not cover.
67 secondary-source records could not be mapped onto an official question (source-specific wording or questions dropped from the 2025 catalogue); they simply did not contribute votes.

Time-sensitive content is not verifiable from a static catalogue: the "Wie heißt die jetzige Bundeskanzlerin/der jetzige Bundeskanzler" question is answered differently by all three sources. Only the official 2025 option set constrains it.

extraction.pairing: bijective: every official question paired with exactly one of ours

adjudications.issue: Upstream solution field was empty; pipeline patched it to option d (Zwangsarbeit).
adjudications.pdfSays: Aufgabe 15:  Militärdienst | *Zwangsarbeit |  freie Berufswahl |  Arbeit im Ausland [option text is verbatim from the official catalogue; the * marks the three-source consensus answer, NOT a BAMF marking - the catalogue carries no answer key]
adjudications.detail: The official option set matches ours and the three-source consensus selects the Zwangsarbeit option, which is the option our solution letter points at. The patch was correct. Note the catalogue itself supplies no answer key, so this is confirmed against consensus, not against a BAMF marking.

adjudications.issue: All four options and the solution were empty upstream; the pipeline SYNTHESIZED the option set (a Cottbus / b Potsdam / c Brandenburg an der Havel / d Frankfurt (Oder)) and the solution b.
adjudications.pdfSays: Aufgabe 7 (Brandenburg): *Potsdam. |  Cottbus. |  Brandenburg. |  Frankfurt/Oder. [option text is verbatim from the official catalogue; the * marks the three-source consensus answer, NOT a BAMF marking - the catalogue carries no answer key]
adjudications.detail: The official Brandenburg question offers the same four cities, so the synthesis happened to reproduce the real option set, and Potsdam is correct. Label deviations: the catalogue prints "Brandenburg." where ours says "Brandenburg an der Havel" and "Frankfurt/Oder." where ours says "Frankfurt (Oder)", and the catalogue's options carry trailing periods. Content-equivalent, but this option set was invented rather than extracted and only luck makes it right — it should be replaced with the extracted official text rather than left as a synthesis.

adjudications.issue: Same upstream defect as BB07; the pipeline SYNTHESIZED a Frankfurt am Main / b Kassel / c Wiesbaden / d Darmstadt with solution c.
adjudications.pdfSays: Aufgabe 7 (Hessen):  Kassel. |  Darmstadt. |  Frankfurt. | *Wiesbaden. [option text is verbatim from the official catalogue; the * marks the three-source consensus answer, NOT a BAMF marking - the catalogue carries no answer key]
adjudications.detail: The official Hessen question offers the same four cities and Wiesbaden is correct. One label deviation: the catalogue prints "Frankfurt." where ours says "Frankfurt am Main". Content-equivalent; same caveat as BB07 about invented option sets.

adjudications.issue: Option d contained a Cyrillic U+0435 homoglyph; corrected to "das Ministerium für Staatssicherheit."
adjudications.pdfSays: Aufgabe 199:  das Parlament. | *das Ministerium für Staatssicherheit. |  eine regierende Partei. |  das Ministerium für Volksbildung. [option text is verbatim from the official catalogue; the * marks the three-source consensus answer, NOT a BAMF marking - the catalogue carries no answer key]
adjudications.detail: Our option d now matches the official Latin-script text exactly and no Cyrillic characters remain in the record. The correction was right.

adjudications.issue: Pipeline reported that the three city-states have no Landeshauptstadt question and carry a "Stadtstaat" question instead.
adjudications.pipelineChose: no Landeshauptstadt question for BE, HB, HH
adjudications.pdfSays: BE: official Landeshauptstadt question=false, official Stadtstaat question=yes (Aufgabe 7); ours Landeshauptstadt=false, ours Stadtstaat=true. HB: official Landeshauptstadt question=false, official Stadtstaat question=yes (Aufgabe 7); ours Landeshauptstadt=false, ours Stadtstaat=true. HH: official Landeshauptstadt question=false, official Stadtstaat question=yes (Aufgabe 7); ours Landeshauptstadt=false, ours Stadtstaat=true
adjudications.detail: The official catalogue genuinely omits the Landeshauptstadt question for the three city-states and asks about the Stadtstaat status instead. Our dataset mirrors the catalogue, and all 16 states have exactly 10 questions with no cross-state contamination.

adjudications.issue: Six-plus groups of federal questions share a stem with different option sets (e.g. "Welches Land ist ein Nachbarland von Deutschland?" 5x).
adjudications.pipelineChose: 6 repeated federal stems in our dataset
adjudications.pdfSays: 6 repeated stems in the official catalogue, largest groups: 5x (Aufgabe 192, Aufgabe 195, Aufgabe 197, Aufgabe 198, Aufgabe 200); 5x (Aufgabe 222, Aufgabe 223, Aufgabe 227, Aufgabe 229, Aufgabe 233); 2x (Aufgabe 5, Aufgabe 119); 2x (Aufgabe 26, Aufgabe 27); 2x (Aufgabe 32, Aufgabe 54); 2x (Aufgabe 107, Aufgabe 110)
adjudications.detail: The repetition is a genuine property of the official catalogue, which deliberately reuses a stem with different option sets. It is not a duplication bug, and because pairing keyed on question plus option set the duplicates were still matched bijectively.

findings.note: 300/300 federal records sit at a different slot than their official Aufgabe number. This is a full permutation, not an off-by-one: F001#1->Aufgabe 153, F002#2->Aufgabe 170, F003#3->Aufgabe 50, F004#4->Aufgabe 230, F005#5->Aufgabe 165, F006#6->Aufgabe 246, F007#7->Aufgabe 222, F008#8->Aufgabe 179, F009#9->Aufgabe 156, F010#10->Aufgabe 97. Every official question is present exactly once, so this only means our `number` field is a dataset index, not the BAMF Aufgabe number.
